title: Interesting Facts
tagline: Discover and share fascinating facts with the world. Available for your device or try it right in your browser.
feature1Desc: A feed of fascinating facts to learn something new every day.
feature2Desc: Keep your favorite facts close with a single tap.
feature3Desc: Search by keyword or explore hashtags and creators.
iosHint: Tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen" — it works like a real app.
desktopHint: Use your browser's menu — "Add to Home Screen" or "Install App".
tabPwaSubtitle: Compatible with iPhone (iOS), Android, and Computers (PC/Mac)
pwaIntro: Install the app directly from your browser without downloading files. It works just like a native app on any device:
pwaIosDesc: In Safari, tap the Share button and select "Add to Home Screen".
pwaAndroidDesc: Tap the 3-dot menu and select "Install app" or "Add to Home Screen".
pwaDesktopDesc: Click the install icon in the address bar or browser menu.
installStep1Desc: Tap the download button and wait for the file to finish downloading.
installStep2Desc: If prompted by Android, enable "Allow from this source" in your browser.
downloadModalConsent: Do you want to download the APK installation file to your device?
pwaIosStep1Desc: In Safari's bottom bar, tap the share icon (the square with an arrow pointing up).
pwaIosStep2Desc: Scroll down the menu and select "Add to Home Screen".
pwaAndroidStep1Desc: Tap the three dots (⋮) in the top-right corner of Chrome or your browser.
pwaAndroidStep2Desc: Select "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
pwaDesktopStep1Desc: In Chrome, Edge, or Brave, click the install icon (computer or +) on the right side of the address bar.
pwaDesktopStep2Desc: Click "Install" in the popup to add the app to your desktop.
